newsitem.title: USA: Jet fuel diffs steady in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Jet fuel diffs steady in thin trade.

text.p: Jet fuel differentials were mostly unchanged Monday with values notionally firmer in the New York Harbor amid quiet dealings.

"It's a real ho hum market. There aren't a lot of buyers and supply seems fine," said a New York Harbor dealer. He noted one seller offered prompt airline quality 54 grade at 1.75 cents over the July heating oil contract on the NYMEX.

Friday, 54 grade was 1.00 cent above the June contract. The June contract expired at session's end that day at a 0.65 cent backwardation to the July contract and jet fuel values chased the new benchmark July contract to close the difference.

In the U.S. Gulf, where the July contract has been the benchmark for the past week, differentiuals were flat with Friday. Jet 54 grade was talked 0.75 to 0.50 cent below the screen while Jet 55 grade was talked 0.25 cent below the screen to unchanged.
